title: Senior Backend Engineer - Acme
text:
Senior Backend Engineer
Acme Corp - Remote (US)

About the role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer to own our payments platform. You will design and ship Go and Python services handling millions of transactions a day, lead migrations off our legacy monolith, and mentor mid-level engineers.

Requirements
- 6+ years building production backend systems
- Deep experience with Go or Python
- PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes
- Experience with payments or other high-integrity domains

Compensation: $170,000 - $210,000 base, plus equity.
